questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent: When a polynomial P(x) = ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + 28 is divided by (x - 2), (x + 3) and (2x + 1), the remainders are 54, 364 and 143/2 respectively. Find the values of a, b and c. [4]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
The graph of y = f(x) has a maximum turning point at (2, 3) and intersects the axes at (0, 2) and (4, 0).
(a) State the range of values of x for which the graph of y = 1/f(x) is decreasing. [2]
(b) Sketch the graph of y = f'(x), showing clearly the axial intercepts. [4]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent: A curve C has equation y = 1 / (bx^2 - 2bx), where b < 0. Sketch C and give, in terms of b where appropriate, the equations of any asymptotes and the line of symmetry, and the coordinates of any turning points. [5]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
A curve C1 has parametric equations x = at(t + 2), y = a(t + 1)^2 where a is a positive constant.
(a) Find, in terms of a, the equation of the normal to the curve at the point where t = 1/2. [4]
(b) Another curve C2 has equation 3e^x + e^y = 4. Given that the normal in part (a) is also tangent to C2 at a point with y-coordinate 0, find the value of a. [3]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
(a) Sketch, on the same axes, the graphs of y = ln(4 - x) and y = 3/x - 2 for x > 0. Hence, solve the inequality 3/x - 2 > ln(4 - x). [4]
(b) Using your answer in part (a), find the solution of 3/x^3 - 2 > ln(4/x^3) for x > 0. [3]
(c) State the solution of the inequality 3/x - 2 < -x for x > 0. [1]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
(a) Sketch the graph of y = (x - 2)^2 - 3|x - 2| + 1, labelling all essential features. [3]
(b) Find the set of values of m such that the line y = m(x - 3) does not intersect the graph. [2]
(c) Describe a sequence of transformations that transforms the graph onto y = (2x - 4)^2 - 6|x - 2| + 4. [2]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.subtopic: Techniques of Integration & Volume of Revolution
questions.textContent:
Find:
(a) integral of (2x + 3) / e^(x^2 + 3x + 1) dx [1]
(b) integral of sin^2(5x) dx [3]
(c) integral of (x - 2) / sqrt(4x - 4x^2 + 7) dx [5]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
Referred to the origin O, points A and B have position vectors a and b. OC is perpendicular to AB and OA : OB = 3 : 2.
(a) Express OC in terms of a and b. [2]
(b) Given that OC is perpendicular to AB and |a|/|b| = 3/2, show that a . b = (3/8)|b|^2. [3]
(c) Hence, by considering |OC|^2, find OC : OB. [3]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
A geometric sequence u1, u2, u3, ... has common ratio r, where r and u1 are positive. A sequence v1, v2, v3, ... is given by vn = ln(un).
(a) Show that v1, v2, v3, ... is an arithmetic sequence. [2]
(b) The sequence un is convergent. Find the range of values of the common difference of vn. [3]
(c) Given that the sum to infinity of un is 9 and sum of first 3 terms is 7, find the values of r and u1. [4]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
Fig. 1 shows a 3-dimensional model of a tent with cross-section ABCDE where AB = ED = 2 m, BC = CD = 1.5 m, and AE = 2x m.
(a) Explain clearly why 1/2 < x < 5/2. [1]
(b) Let the cross-sectional area of the tent be A m^2. Show that A = 2x*sqrt(4 - x^2) + x*sqrt(9/4 - x^2). [4]
(c) Use differentiation to find the exact maximum value of A, proving it is a maximum. [4]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
The function f is given by f: x |-> (2x^2 - 4x - 7) / (x - 2), x in R, x != 2.
(a) Sketch the graph of y = f(x), indicating its turning points and asymptotes. [4]
(b) State the range of f. [1]
(c) The function g is defined on positive integers by g(n) = 2n for odd n, and g(n) = n/2 + 1 for even n. Find g(2) and g(8). [2]
(d) Does the composite function fg exist? Justify your answer. [2]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
A function f has the equation f(x) = (1/5)x^5 + 2x^3 + 10x - 25.
(a) Without using a calculator, and by considering f'(x), explain why f is strictly increasing for all real x. [2]
(b) Hence show that the equation f(x) = 0 has exactly one real root, and find this root correct to 3 decimal places. [3]
(c) Find the set of values of k for which f(x) = k has a root in x < 0. [2]
(d) By considering a sketch of y = f(x) and another suitable curve, determine the number of real roots of f(x) = 10/x. [3]

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.textContent:
A drone flies in a straight line from point A to point B with coordinates (40, 40, 5). At B, it makes a sharp 90 degree turn and thereafter flies in a straight line in the direction of 2i + j + 2k. Eventually, it crashes into a cliff face which is part of the plane 8x + y + 4z = 595 at point C.
(a) Find the coordinates of C. [3]
(b) Determine the acute angle alpha that the path of the drone makes with the cliff face. [3]
(c) Given that the coordinates of A are (q, 120, 1), find the value of q. [2]
(d) Max tracks the drone from point D with coordinates (0, 0, 10). Find the shortest distance from D to the path BC. [3]
